prose: Weaving Spiders co-conspirator S.B. Alger joins Vibe Rant! As a multidisciplinary artist, S.B. creates music, sculpture, paintings and more, teaches guitar and singing, and is a certified Release Coach. Hanging with S.B. is always good for deep thoughts and big laughs!
